governing.label: GLP-1 RA or GIP/GLP-1 RA vs placebo, MACE, Mantel-Haenszel random effects

quotes.quote: we identified 18 eligible studies for inclusion reporting on 16 RCTs

scope.reading: Stefanou 2024 includes 16 RCTs of GLP-1 and GIP/GLP-1 receptor agonists, but its MACE plot has 7 of them; the other 9 do not enter its MACE analysis, so its 16 are not trials missing from our MACE pool. Of the 7, SELECT is the one we pool (shared 1, ours-only 0); the other six are weight-management trials with a handful of MACE events each.
scope.reported_by: external review of the semaglutide-obesity-mace topic (28 Sep 2026)

method_difference.heading: One trial, a different representation
method_difference.reading: Its 0.79 is a Mantel-Haenszel random-effects odds ratio of event proportions; we pool SELECT's time-to-event hazard ratio. Because SELECT carries almost all of its weight (below), the two agree because they are largely the same trial, not an independent result.
method_difference.reported_by: external review of the semaglutide-obesity-mace topic (28 Sep 2026)

caption.quote: Forest plot comparing the risk of MACE in overweight or obese adults without diabetes treated with GLP-1 or GIP/GLP-1 RAs versus placebo.

figure.read_by: Claude Opus 5.5 (lane evid2), from the held image, 28 Sep 2026; column totals 13,696 and 11,008 match the plot's Total row
